## 15 Element 16's read surface: the one screen an assigned employee works from.

The route is this service's own — element 11 fixes the paths of the processing resource, the pick list and the snapshot, and names none for the workstation, whose payload is the two regions of W1 composed (recorded in docs/phase-1-decisions.md). It is a read: nothing on this screen writes, and the actions of the other views' actors — readiness, issues, resume — are not reachable from it.

Method and path
: `GET` `/processing/{processingId}/pick-workstation`

Authentication
: `bearer JWT`
